description.en: Previews and moves supported Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode setup into DSH. Covers skills, commands, agents, instructions, and local or remote MCP servers, with OpenCode V1/V2 JSONC precedence, collision checks, backups, and doctor diagnostics.
description.zh: 预览并将 Claude Code、Codex 与 OpenCode 的受支持配置迁入 DSH。涵盖技能、命令、代理、指令与本地或远程 MCP 服务，支持 OpenCode V1/V2 JSONC 优先级、目标冲突检查、备份与 doctor 诊断。
